title: append_lines must not wipe >1MB channel files (read via blobs API)
desc: DEFECT (cormac review #a047281b finding 1, evidence: main commit 5316ac2 = 1 insertion / 1150 deletions): bin/chatcode:410-414 — for files >1MB GitHub /contents returns encoding='none' content='';  is True for '' so append_lines builds existing='' with a valid sha and the PUT replaces the whole channel with one message. Same unchecked b64decode(info['content']) in update_task (:870-) and claim_task (:897-). SCOPE: append_lines + the task/claim read paths. ACCEPTANCE: (1) one command proving a >1MB channel survives an append with zero message loss — offline stub or live scratch file, output in PR; (2) red on main, green on branch; (3) no format changes (R10). Repro to build on: tests/repro_t-56ac_branch_and_bigfile.py + PR #4 evidence.
